verdict.rationale: Capacities documents offline-first behavior (work offline, sync when back online, offline search) and a full/scheduled export to Markdown+CSV/front-matter that is 'easy to reuse... work with programmatically,' giving some data ownership. However, there is no evidence the primary store is plain local files usable without the app day-to-day — the live working format is the app's own sync/cloud store, and export is a periodic snapshot rather than the native storage format. Missing for 10: evidence of a genuine local-first primary file format (e.g. markdown files on disk that the app just syncs), and confirmation that full functionality (not just search) works offline without any cloud dependency.
